main.description: A steward's written summary of where a deliberation without a vote landed. It is the steward's reading, not the community's verdict. Served only for a cabildeo of kind forum or persuasion, and only when written by a current steward of the cabildeo's community.

communityUri.description: The board the cabildeo's community resolves to.

cited.description: Positions of the same cabildeo that the conclusion summarizes. Shown beneath it so readers can see what it rests on.

followUp.description: A cabildeo opened because of this conclusion. Never created automatically.
